law: Using the class in your app, you can get a token that you use on your server to set and query two binary digits of data per device, while maintaining user privacy.
For example, you might use this data to identify devices that have already taken advantage of a promotional offer that you provide, or to flag a device that you’ve determined to be fraudulent.
You use the class to generate a special cryptographic key on the device, and have Apple attest to the validity of that key.
You then use that key to assert the validity of your app whenever you request sensitive data from your server.
Reduce fraudulent use of your services by managing device state and asserting app integrity.
Preparing to use the app attest service.
